routes.name: Universal cut-symbol verification, with independent review pending

scope: The selected audit resolves the cut-symbol step, not the other manuscript comparisons. Source assertions are unverified inputs, not evidence that they hold.

C9000044.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 044 (The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture.; papers: The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary quivers; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_HIKITA.statement: The coefficient-compatible equivariant cohomological Hikita isomorphism for arbitrary quivers and regular stability.

C_MINUSCULE.statement: Coefficient-preserving BFN abelianization and generation by dressed positive and negative subset coweights.
C_MINUSCULE.source_locator: preliminaries.tex, prop:minuscule; Weekes arXiv:1903.07734v2, Proposition 3.1 and Remarks 3.3-3.4
C_MINUSCULE.source_findings: Primary-source lookup supports subset-minuscule generation with loops and multiple arrows. Lemma 2.10 is a nilHecke pushforward identity, not the Laurent model. Arbitrary-flavor interfaces remain outside this mission.

C_COEFF_SURJ.statement: The coefficient ring P^W surjects onto the full topological fixed-scheme quotient B_0.

C_LAURENT.statement: With no flavor and one loop available per positive-rank vertex, A_0 identifies with (direct sum_lambda P r_lambda)^W without polynomial localization.

C_CUT_SYMBOL.statement: For every allowed multipartition and support length L, the invariant cut quotients shifted by delta_m surject onto F_L/F_(L-1) as graded vector spaces, preserving the full scheme quotient.

C_CUT_ABSTRACT.statement: The cut-symbol theorem holds over every commutative Q-algebra for the explicit free-module invariant Laurent algebra; its full-charge quotient is generated by invariant coefficients.

C_CUT_GENERATION.statement: Over every commutative Q-algebra, the explicit invariant Laurent algebra is generated by invariant coefficients and dressed positive/negative subset coweights; its full-charge quotient is consequently coefficient generated.

C_CUT_CORE.statement: For arbitrary nonnegative disjoint split sizes, root and framing excess exponents are the cut exponents, the oriented root factors have the stated parity, and a nonempty overlap strictly lowers support cardinality.
C_CUT_CORE.mechanical_status: Kernel compilation succeeded with no proof holes; independent statement-fidelity review remains pending.

C_CUT_ZERO.statement: The charge-preserving Laurent derivations descend to zero on the coefficient-generated quotient; arbitrary dressing multiples eliminate all zero-slot power sums.

C_CUT_TRACE.statement: Disjoint decompositions at a fixed representative form exactly H/H_S, giving the signed, unnormalized stabilizer trace with no additional multiplicity.

C_CUT_REYNOLDS.statement: Selected and unselected block dressings span the split invariant ring; Reynolds averaging makes every invariant element of the cut ideal annihilate the symbol.

C_CUT_SHIFT.statement: The Laurent polynomial degree is delta_m=C(v)-D_m+w.(v-l), an integer that is nonnegative, including remaining loops and all boundary cases.

C_KERNEL.statement: Stable-pair testing gives a coefficient-compatible surjection B_F to H_F^*(X).

C_COUNTING.statement: Cut-quotient recurrence identifies the multipartition sum with Hausel's Betti polynomial at determinant stability.
C_COUNTING.source_findings: Reineke-Rhoades-Tewari arXiv:2207.11861v2 establishes cocircuit quotient connections, not this support-length symbol surjection.

C_LOOP_CASE.statement: For looped quivers at determinant stability, the coefficient map identifies B_0 with ordinary cohomology.

C_DEFORM.statement: Flavor lifting, homogeneous descent after loop removal, and regular-stability Betti independence extend the loop case.

C_FULL_TORUS.statement: The full-topological-torus fixed quotient equals equivariant cohomology under the coefficient map.

C_POLY_MAPS.statement: Polynomial Hall-to-Coulomb maps specialize without inverting rotation or arrow parameters, with the required signs.

C_ROOT_CHARGE.statement: Nontrivial minuscule charges decompose into the stated root-supported charges.

C_ROOT_MOMENT.statement: A root charge of character weight zero is realized by a moment-level block with scalar stabilizer.

C_COCHAR.statement: Regularity forces the cocharacter-fixed and full-torus-fixed scheme ideals to agree.
